name: io.github.swissspidy/trod
title: trod
description: Self-morphing tools: the agent writes a file and it becomes a live MCP tool mid-session.

environmentVariables.name: TROD_ALLOW_EXEC
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let tools run. Tool code runs outside the client's permission prompts: meant for ephemeral containers.

environmentVariables.name: TROD_PROJECT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Project directory whose .trod/ holds the tools (default: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or the working directory).
